extraction.name: ChartQA
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark covering 9.6K human-written questions as well as 23.1K questions generated from human-written chart summaries.
extraction.creator: Ahmed Masry, Do Xuan Long, Jia Qing Tan, Shafiq Joty, Enamul Hoque
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors crawled charts from four online sources (Statista, Pew Research, Our World In Data, OECD), extracting chart images, data tables, metadata, SVG files, and text descriptions. They then collected human-authored QA pairs via Amazon Mechanical Turk and automatically generated additional QA pairs using a T5 model on human-written chart summaries.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: For sources where underlying data tables were unavailable (like Pew), only chart images were crawled. For generated questions, invalid or unanswerable questions were filtered out using a heuristic that checked if the answer could be found in the chart data table.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Real-world chart images (bar, line, and pie charts) covering various topics (economy, politics, industry, etc.), along with their underlying data tables, metadata, SVG files, and associated text descriptions/summaries.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowdworkers were asked to write compositional and visual questions with answers for each chart. Another annotator then answered the same questions. Exact matches were considered correct, while mismatches were manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Agreement between crowd workers based on exact matches was 61.04%. A manual check of 500 random samples considering typos and lexical variations showed a higher agreement of 78.55%.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: T5 models (one for answer extraction and one for answer-aware question generation)
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset contains some noise, including typos and informal language in the questions. Additionally, despite heuristic filtering, a small percentage of the machine-generated questions may still be incomplete or unanswerable.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed as a benchmark for training, validation, and testing models on the task of Chart Question Answering (ChartQA).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data preparation involved extracting underlying data tables, metadata, SVG files, text descriptions, and bounding box information for chart elements from SVG files. For scenarios without accessible data tables, a ChartOCR model was adapted to extract data tables by locating chart elements and estimating data values.
